# AB Colors

> AB Colors is a signage, branding and printing company in Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, India. For nearly two decades it has designed, manufactured and installed LED sign boards, 3D letters, ACP cladding, shop and office branding, promotional displays, flatbed UV prints, corporate gifts and digital printing for businesses across Tamil Nadu, from its own manufacturing units in Trichy.

Key facts:

- Office: 4th Floor, Pearls Tower, 26, Karur Bypass Road, opp. Kalaignar Arivalayam, next to Taj Marriage Hall, Kela Chinthamani, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620002, India
- Manufacturing units: No. 3, Makilampoo Street and 10, Nehru Street, Sanjeevi Nagar, Trichy 620002
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98422 75299 (also +91 99425 21000 and +91 75983 49936)
- Email: bala@abcolors.in
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:30 PM
- Founders: Arun Kumar and Balaji
- Service area: Trichy and businesses across Tamil Nadu
- Quotes: free; share the size, material and location through the website form, phone or WhatsApp

## Services

- [LED Signages & 3D Sign Boards](https://abcolors.in/service-led-signage): 3D acrylic LED letters, SS 304 lip letters, titanium letters, glow sign boards, router-cut ACP cladding and totem pylons, with IP67 waterproof LED modules and on-site installation
- [Promotional Products & Event Displays](https://abcolors.in/service-promotional-products): roll-up standees, sandwich acrylic boards, branded canopies, feather and table flags and banners printed at 1440 DPI
- [Corporate & Retail Branding](https://abcolors.in/service-branding): in-shop acrylic displays, reception logos, frosted and etched glass films, one-way vision, vehicle and fleet graphics, wall coverings and building wraps
- [Flatbed Direct UV Printing](https://abcolors.in/service-flatbed-uv-printing): direct printing on acrylic, glass, wood, MDF, ACP, foam board and metal up to 100 mm thick, with white ink and spot varnish effects
- [Corporate Gifting](https://abcolors.in/service-corporate-gifting): employee joining kits, diaries, laser-engraved pens and card holders, trophies, mementos and the Touch Art Frame
- [Digital Printing](https://abcolors.in/service-digital-printing): visiting cards with foil stamping and spot UV, brochures, flyers, letterheads, calendars and die-cut stickers
- [All services](https://abcolors.in/service): overview of every service
